units.emptyBodyAdmin: Add each factory, production unit or godown, then the places inside it where stock is kept.

moving.title: Moving goods between units
moving.note: with a delivery challan; e-way bill when the value is above the limit. Stock leaves one unit and arrives at the other only when received.
moving.price: so each unit's cost is real: goods move between units at their material and factory cost.
moving.moulds: carry their current unit; a mould can only run on a machine in the unit where it is.
moving.gstin: a transfer is not a sale. Each unit must be on the GST registration as a place of business; confirm with your CA.
